verdict.rationale: Docs clearly describe sending real-time custom events via the Track/Pipelines API (docs-3, docs-7) and triggering automations specifically when a profile performs an event (docs-12), which directly matches the developer story of firing an event to trigger a person-specific automation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that per-person triggering works reliably at scale, and more detail on event payload/attribute matching nuances.
